response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer, but the role demands native-level Japanese, strong C for UNIX/embedded development, Linux kernel source-code analysis, and network-security domain expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching) — none of which are evidenced. His C/C++ exposure is limited to a brief stint in 2014–2015, his languages are English, Romanian, and German, and his career trajectory is web platforms and TypeScript/Node.js, making this a fundamental mismatch despite his seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience with strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Some low-level and systems experience (DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux)
Demonstrated ownership across full lifecycle, open-source contributions, and knowledge-sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement for the role
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, security-protocol (MACsec, 802.1X), or Linux kernel modification experience
C proficiency appears outdated and minimal; recent stack is entirely web-focused (TypeScript, Node.js, React)

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking/security or Linux kernel experience
Strong general engineering seniority and craftsmanship
